4-302.14
Accurate chemical test kit that measures concentration in mg/L (ppm) not provided for the chemical in use.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of sanitizing solutions shall be provided.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Today there were no test strips for the chlorine dishwasher sanitizer and the test strips that were present for the quat sani hose were expired by a year. Correct by ordering these test strips and training staff on how to use them.
3-501.14
Improper cooling times and temperatures.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Cooked time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled: within 2 hours from 57 degrees C (135 degrees F) to 21 degrees C (70 degrees F); and within a total of 6 hours from 57 degrees C (135 degrees F) to 5 degrees C (41 degrees F) or less. Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 5 degrees C (41 degrees F) or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient temperature, such as reconstituted foods and canned tuna.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Today the gravy temped at 53F while other items in the cooler were under 41F. Gravy is offered at breakfast which ends at 9:30am indicating the gravy was improperly cooled. Correct by discarding and educating staff on proper cooling methods or decide to discard any gravy at the end of breakfast service.
2-102.12
No Certified Food Protection Manager associated with the establishment; supervisory education requirements not met.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: At least one employee that has supervisory and management responsibility and the authority to direct and control food preparation and service shall be a certified food protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an accredited program.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: no CFPM on staff. correct in the next 90 days by having a PIC staff member take the course.
4-501.114
Chlorine solution maintained at improper concentration.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Chlorine solution used for sanitizing shall be maintained between 50-100ppm or per manufacturers instructions.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Today the dishwasher was not dispensing chlorine. correct by using the 3-comp sink for ware washing until the dishwasher has been serviced and is dispensing chlorine sanitizer at a concentration of 50-100ppm.
